extractedItems.title: Ball hits player's own equipment
extractedItems.question: If you hit your shot and your ball accidentally bounces off your golf bag, what do you do next?

choices.text: Add a one-shot penalty and replay the shot.
Play the ball as it lies, with no penalty.
Pick up the ball and drop it nearby.
Move your equipment and replay the shot.

extractedItems.explanation: You must play the ball as it lies with no penalty if it accidentally hits you or your equipment.
extractedItems.imagePrompt: A teenage girl golfer on the fairway accidentally has her ball bounce off her golf bag after a shot. She looks surprised but ready to play the ball from where it stopped.
extractedItems.imageAlt: Teen girl golfer on fairway, golf ball has bounced off her bag, ready to play the ball as it lies.

extractedItems.title: Ball strikes an outside influence
extractedItems.question: Your ball accidentally hits a dog running across the course. What should you do?

choices.text: Play the ball as it lies, no penalty.
Replay the shot and add a penalty.
Drop a ball two club lengths from the spot.
Leave the ball and skip your next shot.

extractedItems.explanation: If your ball accidentally hits an outside influence, like an animal, play the ball as it lies without penalty.
extractedItems.imagePrompt: A teenage boy golfer on the fairway watches as his golf ball accidentally hits a running dog. The dog looks startled, and the ball has come to rest nearby.
extractedItems.imageAlt: Teen boy golfer watches as his golf ball hits a dog on the fairway.

extractedItems.title: Ball hits another ball at rest
extractedItems.question: What should you do if your ball in motion hits another ball that was at rest, not on the green?

choices.text: Add two penalty strokes.
Play your ball as it lies, without penalty.
Replay the shot.
Drop your ball at the nearest point.

extractedItems.explanation: If your ball hits another ball at rest (not on the green), play your ball as it lies with no penalty.
extractedItems.imagePrompt: A teenage girl golfer on the fairway has just played a shot and her ball has hit a stationary ball belonging to another player.
extractedItems.imageAlt: Teen girl golfer's ball hits another ball at rest on fairway.

extractedItems.ruleName: Ball in motion accidentally hits ... the flagstick
extractedItems.title: Your ball hits the flagstick in the hole
extractedItems.question: What happens if your ball accidentally hits the flagstick left in the hole after your shot?

choices.text: You must replay the shot.
You get a penalty stroke.
You play the ball as it lies, no penalty.
You must remove the flagstick and replace your ball.

extractedItems.explanation: If your ball hits the flagstick in the hole, play the ball as it lies without penalty.
extractedItems.imagePrompt: A teenage boy on the putting green has just putted and his ball accidentally hits the flagstick which was left in the hole.
extractedItems.imageAlt: Teen boy's golf ball hits flagstick in the hole on green.

extractedItems.ruleName: Ball in motion accidentally hits ... the opponent in match play
extractedItems.title: Ball accidentally hits opponent in match play
extractedItems.question: During match play, your ball accidentally hits your opponent. What do you do?

choices.text: Replay the stroke only if both are on the green.
Always replay the shot.
Play the ball as it lies unless on the green.
Add a penalty stroke and replay the shot.

extractedItems.explanation: Play the ball as it lies with no penalty, except if both were on the green before the stroke; then you replay the shot.

reviewedItems.title: Ball hits player's own equipment

choices.text: Add one penalty stroke and replay the shot.
Play the ball from where it comes to rest, with no penalty.
Pick up the ball and drop it as close as possible to the bag.
Move your bag and replay the shot.

choices.text: Play the ball as it lies, with no penalty.
Replay the shot and add a penalty.
Drop a ball within two club lengths of where it hit the dog.
Skip your next shot.

reviewedItems.explanation: If your ball in motion hits an outside influence such as a dog, you must play your ball as it lies with no penalty.

choices.text: Add two penalty strokes and play your ball from where it comes to rest.
Play your ball as it lies, with no penalty.
Replay your shot from the original spot.
Drop your ball as close as possible to where the balls made contact.

reviewedItems.explanation: If your ball accidentally strikes another ball at rest (not on the green), you play your ball from its resting place without penalty.

reviewedItems.ruleName: Ball in motion accidentally hits ... the flagstick
reviewedItems.title: Your ball hits the flagstick in the hole
reviewedItems.question: On the putting green, if your ball accidentally hits the flagstick that is left in the hole, what should you do?

choices.text: Replay the shot from the same spot.
Add a penalty stroke and play the ball from where it stops.
Play the ball as it lies, no penalty.
Remove the flagstick and replace your ball before playing on.

reviewedItems.explanation: There is no penalty if your ball hits the flagstick left in the hole. You simply play the ball from where it comes to rest.

reviewedItems.ruleName: Ball in motion accidentally hits ... the opponent in match play
reviewedItems.title: Ball accidentally hits opponent in match play
reviewedItems.question: During match play, if your ball accidentally hits your opponent, what should you do according to the Rules?

choices.text: Replay the stroke only if both balls were on the putting green.
Always replay the shot, wherever you are on the course.
Play the ball as it lies unless both balls were on the green.
Add a penalty stroke and replay the shot.

reviewedItems.explanation: In match play, if your ball accidentally hits your opponent, play your ball as it lies except when both balls were on the green before the stroke. Then, you must replay the shot.
